title: Multi hazard risk assessment through geospatial analysis and machine learning

primary.rationale: Deterministic query-to-theme assignment for owner calibration; not an AI judgement.

short_summary: Climate change, increased frequency of natural hazards and growing urban populations all have created a greater necessity for conducting comprehensive multi-hazard assessments using Geographical Information Systems (GIS). Therefore, this research paper proposes developing a machine learning and GIS based methodology to identify and map zones of multi-hazard risk through use of integrated geospatial and environmental variables.
